history.title: Your journey
history.emptyState: No visits yet. Activate a Passport and start exploring.

tour.offerBody: Sixty seconds, eight stops — we'll show you where everything lives. You can skip at any time.

welcome.title: Welcome to Epocheye
welcome.body: A quick tour to show you around. Tap Next to begin — we'll walk you through every part of the app.

search.title: Find any place
search.body: Search for heritage sites and places right from here.

bell.title: Notifications
bell.body: Reminders, updates and news about the sites you follow appear here.

hud.title: Your progress
hud.body: Your level, day-streak and XP grow as you visit sites and explore.

map.title: Discover nearby
map.body: Heritage sites near you show on the map. Tap a marker to open its story.

nearest.title: Your nearest site
nearest.body: We point you to the closest Epocheye venue with one-tap directions.

rank.title: Explorer rank
rank.body: Your Passport tracks your rank and XP as a keeper of history.

stamps.title: Collect stamps
stamps.body: Earn a stamp for every heritage site you visit — they appear here.

streak.title: Daily streak
streak.body: Open Epocheye each day to keep your streak alive.

story.title: On this day
story.body: A fresh moment in history every day — tap to explore the site behind it.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.body: Update your details and switch the app between English, Hindi and Bengali — all from here.

language.title: Choose your language
language.body: Switch the app and AI narration between English, Hindi and Bengali.

site.body: At a site, open AR to watch its history come alive over the real monument.

scan.title: Point and scan
scan.body: Aim your camera at an artifact and tap Detect to identify it and unlock its story.

passport.title: Unlock with a Passport
passport.body: A Passport unlocks the full AR experience at a site. Pick one when you're ready.

finish.title: You're all set
finish.body: That's the tour! Explore at your own pace — replay it anytime from Account.

update.availableSubtitleGeneric: Tap to get the latest features and fixes

maintenance.adminHint: Admin? Press and hold the logo.

offline.inlineMessage: You're offline right now. Reconnect and this will pick up where it left off.

offline.scanMessage: Scanning needs a connection to identify what you’re pointing at. Reconnect to try again.
offline.suggestMessage: You're offline, so this suggestion can't be sent yet. Reconnect and send it then.
offline.purchaseMessage: Payments need a secure connection. Reconnect to continue.

restoration.frameHint: Frame the wall, then tap to capture
restoration.noCamera: No camera available on this device
restoration.permissionBody: The restoration is drawn over a photo you take, so the camera has to be on.
restoration.shareFailed: Couldn't prepare that image to share.
restoration.holdStill: Hold still — a brighter shot takes longer to capture
restoration.torchWarning: Many protected monuments prohibit torches. Check the site's signage before using this.
restoration.imageTitle: The room, as it was painted
restoration.wipeCta: Hold it up in the room

arCapability.checkingBody: Checking what this phone can do…

install.title: One quick install and you're in.
install.body: Your phone supports AR. It just needs Google's AR software, which isn't installed yet.

unsupported.title: You'll see this one a different way.
unsupported.body: Locking the reconstruction onto the real walls needs hardware this phone doesn't have. Everything else is the same — the same reconstruction, the same evidence behind it.

platform.title: Not on iPhone yet.
platform.body: The world-locked view isn't in this build for iPhone yet. You can explore the full reconstruction in 3D in the meantime.

none.title: Nothing to stand in front of here — yet.
none.body: No reconstruction has been set up at this site.

reconstruction.none: No reconstruction is set up here yet.
reconstruction.resolving: Hold steady — locking the reconstruction in place…
reconstruction.hereMoveSlowly: You’re here — move the phone slowly to lock on…
reconstruction.showAnyway: I’m already here — show it ({{distance}} by GPS)

journey.ctaHint: A guided walk through the palace with Tipu Sultan as your host

resume.title: Pick up where you left off?

leave.title: Leave the journey?
leave.body: Your place is saved. Come back to it from this site's page.

noHost.title: This journey isn't ready here yet.
noHost.body: The host is still being prepared. Come back soon.

arrival.title: Stand on the lawn, facing the palace
arrival.findGround: Point the phone at the grass and move it slowly
arrival.tapToPlace: Tap the ground where you would like him to stand
arrival.appeared: He is here. Turn the sound up.
arrival.leading: He's going inside — taking you with him…
arrival.stayed: Take your time. Follow him when you're ready.
arrival.loadFailed: Couldn't bring the figure in. Check your connection and try again.
arrival.audioOnly: AR isn't available on this phone, so Tipu Sultan will speak without appearing.
arrival.voiceFailed: The welcome couldn't play. You can carry on.

prepare.title: Walk forward, towards the pillars
prepare.earphones: Put your earphones in now, before you start. The guide is spoken and the palace is a quiet place — but they're not required, the phone speaker works too.
prepare.arCaution: The camera view can lose its place — in bright sun, on a plain wall, or if the phone gets warm. If that happens the app will say so and you can try again. Move slowly, and keep an eye on where you're walking.
prepare.disclaimerTitle: What you are about to hear
prepare.disclaimerHistory: The history comes from the Archaeological Survey of India's archives and from published books on the palace.
prepare.disclaimerStorytelling: The storytelling — the voice, the phrasing, the way it is told — is generated by AI.
prepare.disclaimerFigure: The figure is a depiction, drawn from portraits painted in his lifetime. No likeness of Tipu Sultan was taken from life.

caching.title: Preparing your guide
caching.offline: You're offline — playing what's already saved
caching.partial: Some files couldn't be saved. They will stream when you reach them.

guide.title: Listen as you walk
guide.seeReconstruction: See this room as it was
guide.autoHint: Each stop plays on its own. Pause any time.
guide.autoNext: Walking on to the next stop in a moment.
guide.audioFailed: This stop's audio wouldn't play. Moving on in a moment.
guide.audioFailedStopped: This stop's audio wouldn't play. Try it again, or move on when you're ready.
guide.notRecorded: This stop hasn't been recorded yet.
guide.lockedBody: The first {{free}} of {{total}} stops are free. Unlock the palace to hear this one and the rest, and to see the restored views that go with them.
guide.fallbackNotice: Playing in English — this stop has not been recorded in your language yet.
guide.finished: That was the last stop. Now try pointing the camera at something.
guide.empty: No audio stops have been recorded here yet.

explore.title: What are you looking at?
explore.hint: Point at a pillar, an arch, a painted wall — then tap the shutter.
explore.needsAr: Point and learn needs AR on this phone. You can finish the journey from here.
explore.tapToPlace: Tap where you'd like the card to sit
explore.placed: Walk around it — the card stays where you put it.
explore.rejected: Couldn't make that out. Try a clearer view, a little closer.
explore.notHere: Point and learn isn't available here right now.
explore.captureFailed: The camera didn't catch that. Try again.
explore.placeFailed: That card couldn't be placed. Try again.
explore.unknown: Nothing to tell you about that one yet.
explore.limit: That's all the scans for today here.
explore.paywall: You've used the free scans for this site.
explore.error: Couldn't reach the guide. Check your connection and try again.

done.title: That's the palace
done.body: Come back any time — your place is saved.

gate.outsideTitle: This journey runs at the palace
gate.outsideBody: Tipu's Summer Palace is on Albert Victor Road in Bengaluru. Open this again when you're at the gates and he'll be waiting.
gate.unavailableTitle: We can't tell where you are
gate.unavailableBody: The journey only runs at the palace, so it needs your location. Turn location on for Epocheye and try again.

arSession.dark: It's too dark to make out the room. More light will help — I've turned the phone's lamp on.
arSession.darkTorchOn: Still too dark. The lamp only reaches a few metres, so try moving somewhere lighter.
arSession.plain: This surface is too plain to lock on to. Point at something with more detail — a carving, a patterned floor, the edge of a wall.
arSession.tooFast: Moving a little slower will help it keep its place.
arSession.cameraBusy: Another app is using the camera. Close it, then come back.
arSession.lost: It's lost its place. Hold still for a moment while it finds the room again.
arSession.hot: The phone is getting warm, so this may stutter for a while. It settles down on its own.

inferred.full: Worked out from photographs and the pillar spacing, not recorded in any source we could reach.

disputed.full: The sources disagree here, and we are not going to pick one for you.
